card.name: Just before anti-inflammatory in NSAID names
card.fires_on: The last piece of "nonsteroidal" (oidal, or anti after it) right before "anti-inflammatory" in NSAID names. Also fires on small words where inflammation-related words come next.

modes.label: Nonsteroidal phrase
modes.description: The ending of nonsteroidal, or the word anti, just before -inflammatory drugs.

modes.label: Anti before inflammatory
modes.description: The word anti right before a hyphenated inflammatory term.

modes.label: Linking word near pain and fever
modes.description: A linking word in a pain-relief list where an inflammation word could follow.
modes.example: may be helpful to reduce pain<< and>> fever.

card.writes: It boosts inflammation and anti-inflammatory words as the next word.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say anti-inflammatory, mostly in NSAID drug names.
